methodological_eligibility.evidence_quote: The idea is to build the model of preference of the Decision Maker and to establish a generic procedure about decision supported by a MCDA tool.

stage1.ineligibility_reason: The paper develops an MCDA preference model for instrumentation decisions, not an EnPI or EnB measurement model.

paper_type.evidence_quote: this paper is based on the case presently studied in the company adixen Vacuum Products (aVP).

stage1.notes: MCDA ranks instrumentation alternatives; no EnPI/EnB model is identified or characterised.
